summary_1line: Bhishma recounts Indra finding the fallen king Vali reborn as an ass, who teaches equanimity in prosperity and adversity.

image_candidates.scene_text: Indra, radiant on the white elephant Airavata, discovers the once-mighty king Vali living as a humble ass inside a deserted chamber.
The ass-form of Vali calmly addresses the triumphant Indra while recalling the lost golden umbrella, jeweled garlands, and dancing Gandharvas of his former glory.
A symbolic vision of Vali’s past splendor—celestial dancers, a golden sacrificial stake, and vast herds of cattle—contrasted with his present life eating chaff.
